results.title: Facing El Chapo
results.overview: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.

results.title: GOAT
results.overview: A small goat with big dreams gets a once-in-a-lifetime shot to join the pros and play roarball, a high-intensity, co-ed, full-contact sport dominated by the fastest, fiercest animals in the world.

results.title: Shelter
results.overview: A man living in self-imposed exile on a remote island rescues a young girl from a violent storm, setting off a chain of events that forces him out of seclusion to protect her from enemies tied to his past.

results.title: Musk
results.overview: An incisive look behind the legend of Elon Musk, the world's most heralded "inventor-entrepreneur" who has enormous influence on the world in which we all live.

results.title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
results.original_title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
results.overview: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go awry when a wild beast appears in the woods.

results.title: Baththa
results.overview: In 1986 Madras, a timid eight-year-old boy accidentally traps a feared gangster inside a deserted school toilet. As the gangster is forced to confront hunger, loneliness and his own vulnerability, an unlikely bond begins to grow between the two.

results.title: Check-In
results.overview: VMX hottest star Aliya Raymundo teams up with sexy siren Anya Austria as two receptionists in a cheap motel. Their quiet routine heats up with the arrival of a mysterious regular guest who begins to stir tension, desire, and conflict in their fragile relationship.

results.title: Lucky Strike
results.overview: A wounded American soldier fights to survive behind enemy lines during WWII's Battle of the Bulge against the Germans, relying on his instinct, spy craft and a hand-radio to evade capture and find his way back to his unit.

results.title: Rolling Loud: The Movie
results.overview: Desperate to reconnect with his distant son, a father secretly takes him to the chaos of Rolling Loud, only to plunge into a wild, frantic search across the massive hip-hop festival when the 13-year-old vanishes into the crowd.

results.title: The Last Sunrise
results.overview: Ry, a college student with a chronic illness, escapes to Mallorca for the summer with her mother, where she unexpectedly falls for a local and begins to embrace living in the moment. But as her condition worsens and long-hidden family secrets come to light, everything she has found before summer's end is threatened.

results.title: The Beast
results.overview: When a militia of unidentified hostiles coordinates a coup against the United States, the president must fight back by utilizing the highly classified offensive capabilities of his armored limousine, nicknamed The Beast.

results.title: Fatherland
results.overview: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.

results.title: La venganza del Charro Negro
results.overview: The return of Leo San Juan and all the legends.

results.title: Jailer 2
results.overview: When a dangerous syndicate expands its reach to threaten his family's peace, retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian goes undercover as a driver. Operating from the shadows, he takes on ruthless new enemies to protect his home.

results.title: The Devil Wears Prada 2
results.overview: Andy Sachs returns to Runway as Miranda Priestly navigates a new media landscape and Runway's position within. The duo reconnect with former assistant Emily Charlton, now the head of a luxury brand that possesses funding which could ensure Runway's survival.

results.title: Don't Leave the Kids Alone
results.original_title: No dejes a los niños solos
results.overview: A mother moves into a new house with her two children. One night she must leave the siblings home alone. What begins as a blast of carefree play soon turns into a claustrophobic horror story.

results.title: By Any Means
results.overview: In 1960s Mississippi, a young Black FBI agent is forced to partner with a notorious mafia hitman to investigate a wave of brutal civil rights murders.

results.title: Lee Cronin's The Mummy
results.overview: The young daughter of a journalist disappears into the desert without a trace—eight years later, the broken family is shocked when she is returned to them, as what should be a joyful reunion turns into a living nightmare.

results.title: The Punisher: One Last Kill
results.overview: As Frank Castle searches for meaning beyond revenge, an unexpected force pulls him back into the fight.

results.title: Drawn Together
results.overview: Marfil, daughter of a powerful Spanish businessman, sees her life in New York turned upside down when she is kidnapped and released without explanation. Her father hires Sebastian Moore as bodyguard and, forced to spend every minute together, an inevitable attraction ignites in a world where nothing is as it seems.
